title: Training Tasks
subtitle: Manage model training tasks
builtinTrainingHint: Uses the existing model_trainer and built-in base models.
runtimeScriptTrainingHint: Select an uploaded custom model ZIP containing the training script and optional initial weights; it runs in the separate model_training_runtime worker.
runtimeDeclaredClassNamesHint: Class names are fixed by the custom-model ZIP and submitted with the training task automatically.
runtimeScriptDataHint: Script-managed data does not use platform datasets or annotations. The package must download or create its own data, and the platform must explicitly allow it in Nacos.
runtimeParametersHint: Fields are generated from the Parameters Schema declared in the custom-model ZIP.
runtimeParametersEmpty: This custom model does not declare configurable script parameters.
runtimeParametersSelectModel: Select a custom model to load its parameter form.
runtimeParameterInvalid: {{name}} does not meet its parameter constraints
runtimeClassNamesRequired: Provide at least one class name for script-managed data
posePlaceholder: Pose training is not supported yet. This is a placeholder type for now.
pleaseAddSource: Please add at least one training source
baseModelDesc: Starting weights for training. Available options are filtered by task type.
datasetCacheModeDesc: Control whether to reuse the trainer-local prepared dataset to avoid downloading and splitting again.
resumeTrainingModel: Resume Model 继续训练模型
resumeTrainingModelDesc: If this source combination has been trained before, continue from a historical model instead of starting from the base model again.
resumeTrainingHint: {{count}} historical training result(s) found for the current sources.
resumeTrainingEmptyHint: Select the sources first. If this combination was trained before, resumable models will appear here.
resumeTrainingPriorityHint: When a resume model is selected, training starts from that historical weight first. The base model is still kept as the default-start configuration.
epochsDesc: How many full passes over the training set to run.
batchSizeDesc: Number of samples per iteration. Larger batches use more GPU memory.
imageSizeDesc: Training resolution after resize. Larger values are often more accurate but slower.
deviceDesc: Devices are reported by the trainer process itself. Linux + NVIDIA usually exposes CUDA. Native macOS Python training may expose MPS. macOS Docker containers usually only expose CPU.
optimizerHint: Keep Ultralytics defaults in most cases. Tune these only when training oscillates, stops too early, or converges poorly.
optimizerNameDesc: Gradient update algorithm. Start with Auto unless you have a reason to override it.
patienceDesc: Stop early after this many epochs without validation improvement.
lr0Desc: Initial learning rate. Too high can cause oscillation; too low can slow convergence.
lrfDesc: Final learning-rate factor relative to the initial learning rate.
momentumDesc: Keeps updates moving in a stable direction, commonly used with SGD-like optimizers.
warmupEpochsDesc: Gradually ramps the learning rate up at the start of training.
cosineLrDesc: Use cosine decay for a smoother learning-rate schedule.
augmentationHint: Control augmentation per training task, especially for sensitive industrial defects such as cracks.
augmentationDegreesDesc: Random rotation range. Use carefully when defect direction matters.
augmentationTranslateDesc: Random translation ratio for improving positional robustness.
augmentationScaleDesc: Random scale range. Excessive scaling may distort true defect size distribution.
augmentationShearDesc: Shear transform intensity. Often less suitable for industrial defect tasks.
augmentationPerspectiveDesc: Perspective distortion strength. Usually keep this very low for planar inspection.
augmentationFliplrDesc: Probability of horizontal flip. Often acceptable when left-right orientation is irrelevant.
augmentationFlipudDesc: Probability of vertical flip. Frequently unsuitable by default in industrial imagery.
augmentationHsvHDesc: Hue jitter amount for color robustness.
augmentationHsvSDesc: Saturation jitter amount. Use carefully in color-sensitive scenarios.
augmentationHsvVDesc: Brightness jitter amount for varying lighting conditions.
augmentationMosaicDesc: Combines multiple images into one. Useful in many cases, but risky for some industrial defects.
augmentationMixupDesc: Blends two images and labels together to improve generalization.
augmentationCopyPasteDesc: Copies labeled objects into new positions or images.
augmentationCloseMosaic: Close Mosaic 最后 N 轮关闭
augmentationCloseMosaicDesc: Turn off Mosaic near the end so training finishes on a more realistic data distribution.
augmentationAutoPolicy: Auto Augment 分类增强策略
augmentationAutoPolicyDesc: Built-in augmentation policy for classification tasks.
augmentationErasingDesc: Randomly masks local regions to improve robustness.
exportOnnxDesc: Also export an ONNX model after training for deployment or inference.
exportOnnxHint: Export and save an additional ONNX model after training
trainingEngineDesc: Ultralytics YOLO is supported first. When more frameworks are added, this area can switch to their own parameter panels.
trainingParamsPending: Select a base model first to reveal the matching training parameters.
trainingParamsReady: The parameter panel is currently expanded for {{engine}} and can be extended by model family later.
staleHint: No status update for more than {{minutes}} minutes
